messages:
PagerBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate (NA region). 5xx spike started ~1759012200. Current 5xx = 22%, p50 latency 420ms, p95 2.4s. Linked dashboard: https://dash.redwood.example.com/d/ingress/route-errors

Samir: Ack, oncall here. Paging SRE now. I'm going to triage scheduler queues and ingress routing.

Ingram: I see large queue depth on scheduler-pool-3 (queue length ~12k), head requests are timing out at gateway after 10s. Looks like a batching scheduler freeze / backlog. Logs show "batch_wait_timeout" repeated.

Nora: Support: customers reporting timeouts? Any high-visibility customers impacted?

SupportLead: Sent initial note to CS: several requests from a mid-market customer timed out, they saw 504s. Opening a customer MTR. No data loss reported.

Mika: Gateway logs -> most 502/504 originate from gateway-proxy -> router -> runtime-scheduler. Here's a sample repeated stack snippet: ```
ERROR runtime.scheduler: batch dispatch timeout at 2025-10-03T14:05:21Z
Traceback (most recent call last):
  ... runtime.timeout.BatchWaitError
```

Samir: Possible causes: massive prefix cache evictions causing slow KV hits, or a runaway request pattern making giant batches and stalling the scheduler. First mitigation: stop accepting large-batch jobs and enable preemptive eviction for low-priority queues.

Ingram: Doing quick mitigations now. Commands: ```
# throttle max tokens per batch to 256
rctl set-config runtime.scheduler.max_batch_tokens=256 --env prod
# enable preemptive eviction for low-priority queues
rctl set-config runtime.scheduler.eviction_mode=preemptive --env prod
```

Samir: I'm also enabling a routing fallback to model-variant-small for non-enterprise customers to reduce tail latency. Applying policy: ```
redwood route update /v1/generate --fallback=variant-small --percent=30 --region=us-east-1
```

OpsOncall: Noted. I'll stand up a mitigation runway: scale scheduler workers and temporarily increase dispatcher threads. ```
kubectl scale deploy/scheduler-pool-3 -n runtime --replicas=8
kubectl patch deploy/scheduler-pool-3 -n runtime -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"scheduler","env":[{"name":"DISPATCHER_THREADS","value":"32"}]}]}}}'
```

Mika: After scaling and config toggles, errors briefly dropped to ~8% but then rebounded. Need to evict large cached KV entries—cache growth correlates with queue freeze.

Ingram: Evicting largest model KV caches for idle models: ```
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal/kvcache/evict?top=10" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```
Result: evicted ~1.2GB, scheduler queue drain rate improved.

SupportLead: Update for CS: status page draft -> "Degraded performance for text-generation endpoints in US; engineers are actively mitigating. No data integrity issues. ETA next update 15 min." :thumbsup:

Samir: Noted progress. Also added a temporary 5s gateway retry window for safe idempotent requests to reduce surface area of immediate client errors. ```
gatewayctl set retry.window=5s --path /v1/generate --env prod
```

PagerBot: Incident update: mitigation actions applied (throttles, eviction, fallback routing, scaled schedulers). 5xx now 3.6% (was 22%).

Nora: Good. Which customers still seeing errors? SupportLead: A handful of calls for enterprise customers doing heavy batch uploads — we're sending guidance to reduce batch size client-side until full recovery.

Mika: Root cause theory: a sudden workload with long-sequence batched requests saturated the scheduler's batching algorithm, combined with KV cache growth (rare model variants) causing dispatch stalls and head-of-line blocking. We'll need postmortem to consider tighter batch caps and better per-tenant backpressure.

Ingram: I've rebalanced queue priorities and enabled 'eviction-on-full' policy for model variants with cold KV. Also lowered max batch wait from 200ms to 80ms to avoid long-blocking batches.

Samir: Launching incident page and timeline. Assigning follow-ups: SRE/Runtime to add guardrail for per-tenant batch tokens (owner: Ingram), Runtime team to implement adaptive fallback earlier (owner: Mika), Support to finalize customer comms (owner: SupportLead).

SupportLead: Customer comms posted to status page and to affected accounts. Will follow up with tailored notes for those who pinged support.

PagerBot: Status check (1759014000): 5xx = 1.4%, p95 latency back to ~350ms. Queue depth steady ~300. No active paging required.

Samir: Thanks team. I'll mark this mitigated in 15m if metrics hold. Please add any additional observations here and file a postmortem request in the incidents backlog.

Nora: Thx. Logging this for oncall handover notes. Oncall shift incoming (Ingram takes primary for follow-ups).

Ingram: Taking the handoff. I'll own the post-incident checklist and coordinate a retro next week. Closing live handoff. :white_check_mark:
